$comment: Merch print files only (no mockups). Trim sizes, bleed, safe areas and methods follow the spyglass-ds and context-ds engines (common vendor print areas; they are conventions, so confirm with the vendor template). Layouts are in inches from the trim. Words are drawn only when passed (the address is the brand's own); `sample` is drawn with --sample. Only the approved lockups (brand/assets/logo.json: the primary logo and the mark, in off-black, off-white or home-red as brand/logo ships them), the share-image themes and the illustration parts are used. Ground variants print a theme to the bleed; one-color variants are the logo and words alone in one brand color on a transparent ground (art needs more than one color, so it is left out of them, and what is left closes up: `flow` says from the top or round the middle, `fixed` parts stay); color is the full-color art on a transparent ground for DTG.

sample.headline: Everything your agent needs to know.

items.name: Cap front panel
items.source: Common front embroidery area on a structured six-panel cap: 4 by 1.75 in. Thread, so one color per file and no bleed.

items.name: Tee front (chest)
items.source: Common adult tee front print area: 12 by 16 in (DTG standard). Garments are not trimmed, so no bleed.

items.name: Tee back
items.source: Common adult tee back print area: 12 by 16 in (DTG standard). No bleed.

items.name: Hoodie front
items.source: Pullover hoodie front, above the pouch pocket: 12 by 10 in is a common area (vendors range from 11.5 by 11.5 to 12 by 12 in). No bleed.

items.name: Tote bag
items.source: Print area on a standard 15 by 16 in canvas tote: 12 by 14 in is common. No bleed.

items.name: Mug wrap (11 oz)
items.source: 11 oz mug wrap: 9 by 3.5 in is a common print area (vendors range from 8.5 to 9.5 in wide), with 0.125 in bleed for the full wrap. The lockup sits on the side away from the handle.

items.name: Die-cut sticker
items.source: Die-cut sticker 3 by 1.75 in, cut along the rounded rectangle (the CutContour path in the SVG, a spot line the cutter reads; it is not printed), with 0.125 in bleed.

items.name: Poster
items.source: Standard 18 by 24 in poster with 0.125 in bleed on every side and a 0.5 in safe margin.
